cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID. Shares of 98 to 99% are given, no count of 99.9%.
cells.note: Every source from 2024 to October 2026 puts enrolment at 98 to 99% of the population. None reaches the 99.9% that stage 4 needs.
